<div class="card card-retractable" style="margin-bottom: 2rem;" onclick="this.classList.toggle('expanded')">

  <p style="text-align: center;font-weight: bold; font-size: 28px;">
  Challenges
  </p>
  The common challenges of these visuals are to **translate complex, abstract concepts into intuitive visual representations**.

  Balance:

  - scientific accuracy;
  - clarity and accessibility;
  - visual appeal.

  Ensure visuals can:

  - stand alone;
  - support understanding across diverse backgrounds.
  </div>

<div class="card-row">

  <div class="card card-retractable" onclick="this.classList.toggle('expanded')">
  
  <p style="text-align: center;font-weight: bold; font-size: 28px;">
  Approach
  </p>
  I **design visuals as conceptual tools**, not just illustrations.

  Key principles:

  - simplifying without losing essential meaning;
  - selecting and adapting representations from multiple sources when needed;
  - combining abstract ideas with concrete representations;
  - ensuring visual coherence and readability across elements;
  - using design to guide attention and highlight key insights.
  
  </div>

  <div class="card card-retractable" onclick="this.classList.toggle('expanded')">

  <p style="text-align: center;font-weight: bold; font-size: 28px;">
  Strengths
  </p>
  - Ability to **design clear and engaging** scientific visuals;
  - translation of **complex concepts into intuitive** representations;
  - **visual synthesis** condensing information from multiple sources;
  - use of design to **support interdisciplinary learning and understanding**;
  - adaptation of visuals to **different communication goals** (attract, explain, summarize).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="card card-retractable" style="margin-bottom: 2rem;" onclick="this.classList.toggle('expanded')">

  <p style="text-align: center;font-weight: bold; font-size: 28px;">
  Impacts
  </p>
  Working on highly interdisciplinary projects (at the interface between biology, medicine, thermodynamic, mathematical modelling, probabilistic ML/AI, data sciences and computational sciences), it is often required to **translate knwoledge from one audiance to another**. To this aim, I developed skills in scientific illustrations to **capture my audiance attention while transmitting the appropriate information**. <br>
  Mathematical **formula often freeze an audiance**: it is necessary to learn how to **present a theoretical concept with simple and engaging visuals** without weakening the content.  
</div>
